scope: RP1 polled GPIO support including Ethernet PHY reset line; no physical GPIO, PHY, Ethernet or SD qualification.

reference.note: Register/bank/pad adaptation; ISC license and copyright retained. Blob ID identifies a file, not a commit.

validation.native_flags: Original bsd.kmod.mk, -Werror, FDT/INTRNG headers; no install or load.
validation.production_callbacks: Clang18 and GCC ASan/UBSan pass: all54pins; bank boundaries27/28,33/34,53/54; GPIO output disconnect/preset/mux/OE sequence; latch SET/CLR/XOR; polled input; reserved bit preservation; alternate function reporting; invalid flags/specifiers; active-low mapping; all resource acquisition/short-BAR failures; bus attach/retained-owner and cleanup retry failures.

limitations: No alternate-function pinctrl provider or GPIO interrupt controller yet; advertised capabilities cover polled GPIO only.
Published provider retained for boot lifetime because cross-tree GPIO handles lack detach reference tracking.
RP1 clocks and Cadence MAC platform initialization still required for Ethernet.
Physical assertion/deassertion of reset pin32 and bus throughput remain untested.
